title: Warranty and third-party parts or service
facts: A warrantor generally may not condition warranty coverage on the consumer's use of a particular branded article or service unless the required item or service is provided free or a lawful FTC waiver applies.
Using an independent repair shop or third-party part does not automatically void an entire warranty.
A warrantor can deny coverage for damage caused by an improper repair or incompatible part when the facts support that exclusion.
Specific warranty terms and the cause of the claimed defect still matter.
